tools.name: check_company
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about a company or wants one checked. Give the company's name and, if known, its city or country. If a recent report on the company is stored, it comes back at once; otherwise a new report starts and the answer says when it will be ready. A new report uses one of the reade

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Use this to see how far a report has got and what has been found so far, or to read a ready report: its date, the main point, any questions to ask, what was found, the next steps, the companies worth a look next and its link. LightRay writes each report: the main point, questions, findings and next

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: Use this to see the reader's recent reports from here, newest first, each with whether it is ready and its link. It uses none of the reader's reports.
